title: Beowulf: Prologue (Lines 1–11)
author: Anonymous (Nowell Codex)
source: London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A. xv, ff. 129r–198v

sentences.translation: Listen! We of the Spear-Danes in days of yore, of the people's kings, have heard of their glory, how those noble princes performed courageous deeds.
